# DesignLayer

> A visual editor for a running React or Angular dev server. It proxies the app, lets a designer select and edit elements like Figma layers, writes each change back into the component source, and serves MCP so a coding agent can receive the designer's notes.

## For agents using DesignLayer

- [Agent handoff (MCP)](docs/agent-handoff.md): client config, the wait_for_change / resolve_change loop, tool reference
- [Using DesignLayer](docs/using.md): install, start screen, CLI flags, shortcuts
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): designlayer.config.mjs, Tailwind, design-system manifests, icons, companions

## For agents editing this repository

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): commands, file map, rules, style
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): what it writes, security model, performance, layout
- [Testing](docs/testing.md): suites and host-pinned tests
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): pull request process
